rows.label: Jade Shadows
rows.note: needs The New War first; unlocks Ascension and Ordis's shop

groups.activity: clear Ascension; throw Boosted Ionic Charges up the elevator
groups.meta: 4.63% blueprint drop per completion; pity currency drops every run
conditions: The extraction capsule is invulnerable during the ride, so killing enemies there doesn't move it; throwing Ionic Charges does.
Boosted Ionic Charges (larger, two marker outlines) speed the elevator 3x for 10 seconds, stacking up to 50 seconds of duration.
Collect the 3 Sister Beacons in the shaft to summon a Sister of Parvos for 5-7 more motes (8-10 on Steel Path) and a 33% arcane chance (guaranteed on Steel Path).
bonuses: Every completion pays 11-13 Vestigial Motes (16-18 on Steel Path), banking toward the 300-mote pity buy.

disclosures.title: boosters do nothing here
disclosures.body: Resource Boosters, loot abilities such as Desecrate and Resourceful Retriever have no effect on Vestigial Motes; they only affect Steel Essence.
